clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, the Empty Water Tube is ready to gather sacred moonwell water for the red crystal on Darkshore’s eastern cliffs.

Sentinels and scholars seek pure lunar essence to study the mysterious red crystal along Darkshore’s eastern ridge. Ordinary glass or flasks can contaminate consecrated water, so investigators visiting Auberdine’s moonwell receive this sealed vial for the work. They carry its filled contents up the mountain slopes to learn how the alien mineral responds to Elune’s magic.
